description: This file is a C++ source implementation for a Text-to-Speech plugin, including class definitions, configuration, event handling, and external library interactions.

classes.name: TextToSpeechImplementation
classes.description: Implementation class for Text-to-Speech plugin handling configuration, event management, and speech operations.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the TTS system with parameters from the service's configuration line.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification sink for TTS events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a notification sink.

methods.name: RegisterWithCallsign
methods.description: Registers a sink with a specific callsign for targeted event dispatch.

methods.name: Request
methods.description: Handles control commands for the TTS system (not implemented).

methods.name: Enable
methods.description: Enables or disables the TTS engine.

methods.name: ListVoices
methods.description: Lists available voices for a specified language.

methods.name: SetConfiguration
methods.description: Sets the TTS engine configuration based on provided parameters.

methods.name: SetFallbackText
methods.description: Sets fallback text for a specific scenario.

methods.name: SetPrimaryVolDuck
methods.description: Sets the primary volume duck percentage.

methods.name: SetAPIKey
methods.description: Updates the API key used for TTS services.

methods.name: SetACL
methods.description: Sets access control list permissions for specific methods.

methods.name: GetConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves current TTS configuration.

methods.name: Enable (bool&)
methods.description: Checks whether TTS is enabled.

methods.name: Speak
methods.description: Initiates speaking of provided text with a specific callsign.

methods.name: Cancel
methods.description: Cancels an ongoing speech identified by speech ID.

methods.name: Pause
methods.description: Pauses ongoing speech.

methods.name: Resume
methods.description: Resumes paused speech.

methods.name: GetSpeechState
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of a speech by speech ID.

methods.name: dispatchEvent
methods.description: Dispatches an event to registered clients.

methods.name: onTTSStateChanged
methods.description: Event callback for TTS system state changes.

methods.name: onVoiceChanged
methods.description: Event callback for voice change events.

methods.name: onWillSpeak
methods.description: Event callback just before speaking starts.

methods.name: onSpeechStart
methods.description: Event callback when speech begins.

methods.name: onSpeechPause
methods.description: Event callback when speech is paused.

methods.name: onSpeechResume
methods.description: Event callback when speech resumes.

methods.name: onSpeechCancelled
methods.description: Event callback when speech is cancelled.

methods.name: onSpeechInterrupted
methods.description: Event callback when speech is interrupted.

methods.name: onNetworkError
methods.description: Event callback for network errors.

methods.name: onPlaybackError
methods.description: Event callback for playback errors.

methods.name: onSpeechComplete
methods.description: Event callback when speech completes.
